# PRD v6 fixtures — strict coverage contract inputs and PRD v5 compatibility records

Frozen by T-66 (`docs/runtime-contracts.md`, "Strict coverage"). Static tests
(`test/coverage-contracts.test.js`) check their structure and provenance only; runtime
behavior against them is proved by the later PRD v6 tickets.

| Directory | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `strict/` | a valid strict PRD (`prd-v1.md`: two requirements, three scenarios, a table reference, a quoted reference, a fenced example and a checkbox-marked scenario), its coverage map (`coverage/prd-v1.json`: a shared check, two tickets on one scenario, an enabling ticket, a deferred scope entry) and its tickets; `expected.json` names the definitions and the non-definitions |
| `invalid/prd/` | one PRD per inventory grammar refusal; `expected.json` maps each file to the exact `INVENTORY_INVALID` detail (line numbers are 1-based in the file) |
| `invalid/coverage/` | one map per refusal; `expected.json` groups them by `COVERAGE_INVALID` (the file cannot be interpreted) and `COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE` (the graph is incomplete against `strict/prd-v1.md` and `strict/tickets/`) with the expected detail |
| `v5/` | records written by the PRD v5 runtime (see below): the formats a strict runtime must keep reading and label `coverage: unverified` |
| `v5-kit/` | the PRD v5 runtime's reader modules, byte-identical to commit `00aad6d`, loaded by tests to prove that the new schemas are refused by the older runtime |

## `v5/` provenance

Produced on 2026-09-12 with `template/scripts/` of commit `00aad6d` on `feat/prd-v5`
(the fixed v5 source; `git diff 00aad6d 07b2210 -- template/` is empty), before any
PRD v6 runtime code existed, on a throwaway project; never regenerated by the new
runtime. Steps, in order (`node scripts/pincer-runtime.cjs …`):

1. `git init`; commit `.gitignore` (`.pincer/`) and `base.txt`.
2. Commit `.prd/prd-v1.md` (`ticketed`, one requirement `R-01` with scenario `S-01`),
   `tickets/T-01-example.md` (check `test "$(cat value.txt)" = good`) and `value.txt`.
3. `register --prd .prd/prd-v1.md` (schema 2 record), `change select prd-v1`,
   `change authorize prd-v1 --agreement <digest> --reference "planning session
   2026-09-12" --excerpt "go ahead with T-01 as written"` (records `G-01`/`A-01`),
   `change activate prd-v1`.
4. `verify T-01` (attempt 1, schema 2), `done T-01`, `change complete prd-v1`; PRD set
   to `built`; committed as the candidate `73aebd8090ef6dcb52bcd8b6269e61cc192f9a2c`
   (base `f90442ae2436132c2582441b42056ab6b4266312`).
5. `check C-01 --candidate <candidate> -- test "$(cat value.txt)" = good` (attempt 2),
   `evidence export` from a draft → `evidence/prd-v1/<candidate>/` (schema 2) and the
   locator `evidence/changes/prd-v1.json`; committed.
6. `status --json`, `resume --json`, `change show prd-v1 --json`, `status`, `resume`
   → `outputs/`.

Layout (leading dots dropped so the fixture's own `.gitignore` does not hide the
runtime state from this repository): `changes/…` = `.prd/changes/…`, `evidence/…` =
`.prd/evidence/…`, `runtime/…` = `.pincer/runtime/…` (`lock/` and `journal/`
omitted: empty), `prd/…` = `.prd/…`, `tickets/…` = `tickets/…`, `gitignore` =
`.gitignore`. Edits after generation, for privacy only: the recording host name in
the attempt records was replaced by `fixture-host.example` and the absolute project
root in `outputs/` by `/fixture`. Nothing else was changed.
